lines.t: Consider it pure joy, my brothers and sisters
Because you know that the testing of your faith
So that you may be mature and complete
If any of you lacks wisdom
Without finding fault and it will be given to you
But when you ask, you must believe and not doubt, not doubt
But when you ask, you must believe and not doubt, not doubt
Because the one who doubts is like a wave of the sea
Blown and tossed by the wind
That person should not expect to receive anything from the Lord
And unstable in all they do
You must believe and not doubt
But when you ask, you must believe and not doubt
